extraction.notes: Reconciliation taken from the FFO/AFFO tables (page 8). Starts from GAAP net loss attributable to common stockholders; company has no separate core FFO, so core fields are null. Zero-valued dash lines (2023 equity in earnings from JV sale, gain on sale of real estate, JV debt extinguishment loss) are included at 0. Ties: -4,098 + 8,008 + 1,376 - 4 = 5,282; 5,282 + 19 + 1,410 + 252 + 27 + 157 - 240 - 30 - 3 = 6,874. Per-share check: 5,282/19,137.577 = 0.28 and 6,874/19,137.577 = 0.36, matching reported. The FFO denominator (19,137,577 diluted shares and units for FFO and AFFO) differs from the income statement diluted count of 18,064,301, which equals basic because of the net loss. Recurring capex is not subtracted in AFFO; the value-add/capex table shows BRT share estimated recurring capex of $1,224,000 for the quarter ended March 31, 2023 (recorded as 1,224 thousand). Page printed numbers: the capex table is on printed page 10 (seq 28).
